neighbours.label: scenes of Jesus in the Gospels, above all the Transfiguration ('Mount of Transfiguration', 'Moses and Elijah', 'My God, my God')
fire: On the mountain, Jesus was transfigured and spoke with Moses and Elijah.
The painting above the altar shows the Transfiguration of Our Lord.
From the cross he cried out, My God, my God, why have you left me?
Peter, James and John saw the Transfiguration from the top of the mount.
Raphael's last work was a large Transfiguration for a French cathedral.
The disciples fell down when Moses and Elijah appeared beside Jesus.
The Feast of the Transfiguration falls on the sixth of August.
The gospel tells of the mount of transfiguration and the voice from the cloud.
quiet: On the mountain, the priest was tired and spoke with two old farmers.
The painting above the altar shows a view of the local harbour.
From the balcony he cried out, My friends, my friends, why have you left me?
Paul, Mark and Luke saw the harbour from the top of the mount.
Raphael's last work was a large portrait for a French banker.
The hikers fell down when snow and ice appeared beside the path.
The Feast of Saint Martin falls on the eleventh of November.
